potted plant.title: Houseplant

reasons.cat: Many common houseplants, especially lilies, are toxic to cats even in small amounts.
reasons.dog: Plants like pothos, aloe, and sago palm can make dogs sick if chewed.
reasons.default: Some houseplants are toxic to pets if chewed or eaten.

potted plant.suggestion: Check that the plant is pet-safe, or move it somewhere your pet can't reach.

knife.title: Sharp Knife

reasons.dog: Dogs may grab knives off counters while searching for food.
reasons.cat: Cats jump on counters and can knock knives off or cut their paws.
reasons.default: Sharp objects can cause serious cuts.

knife.suggestion: Store knives in a drawer or knife block, not on open counters.

scissors.title: Scissors

reasons.default: Pets can injure themselves on sharp edges if scissors are left out.

scissors.suggestion: Keep scissors in a closed drawer when not in use.

bottle.title: Bottle

reasons.dog: Dogs may chew bottles or lick spills from cleaners, alcohol, or medicine.
reasons.cat: Cats may knock bottles over and lick spilled liquids.
reasons.default: Bottles may contain liquids that are dangerous if spilled or chewed.

bottle.suggestion: Keep bottles, especially cleaners and alcohol, in closed cabinets.

wine glass.title: Wine Glass

reasons.cat: Cats often knock glasses off tables, and broken glass can cut paws.
reasons.default: Glass can break, and alcohol is toxic to pets.

wine glass.suggestion: Don't leave glasses on low tables or edges.

vase.title: Vase

reasons.cat: Cats like to knock things over, and vase water or flowers can be toxic.
reasons.default: Vases can tip over and break.

vase.suggestion: Place vases on stable, high surfaces and keep toxic flowers out of the home.

remote.title: Remote Control

reasons.dog: Dogs often chew remotes, and swallowed batteries can cause serious burns.
reasons.default: Chewing on remotes can expose pets to batteries.

remote.suggestion: Keep remotes on high shelves or in a drawer.

laptop.title: Charging Cords

reasons.small_animal: Rabbits and other small pets love to chew cords, which can cause electric shocks.
reasons.default: Laptop and charger cords can be chewed, causing shocks or burns.

laptop.suggestion: Use cord covers and unplug chargers when not in use.

tv.title: TV and Cords

reasons.cat: Cats may climb TV stands, and unsecured TVs can tip over.
reasons.default: Cords behind TVs are easy for pets to chew.

tv.suggestion: Anchor the TV and hide cords behind a cover.

oven.title: Oven

reasons.cat: Cats may jump onto hot stovetops.
reasons.default: Hot surfaces can burn curious pets.

oven.suggestion: Keep pets out of the kitchen while cooking and use stove knob covers.

toaster.title: Toaster

reasons.default: Toasters get hot, and their cords can be pulled down.

toaster.suggestion: Unplug toasters and push them to the back of the counter.
